name: figma-pixel-check
description: Figma to web, checked: per-section geometry, pixel, colour and style checks plus a responsive audit

plugins.name: figma-pixel-check
plugins.description: Visual QA for Figma to web: compares a built page with its Figma frame section by section (geometry, pixels, colours and Figma's own values: fonts, radii, strokes, shadows, gap, padding) and checks it at six phone sizes. Plain Node + Playwright, runs in CI.
